user.title: Track launches from a site
user.description: Reads Launch Library 2 (thespacedevs.com), filtered to launches at or near the site you name below.

data.upcoming_count: How many upcoming matching launches to track
data.near_window_hours: Switch to live polling this many hours before launch

data_description.site_filter: Case-insensitive text resolved to a Launch Library location, e.g. "Vandenberg" or "Cape Canaveral" - matched once at setup and then filtered by that location's exact id on every poll. Leave blank to track all launches worldwide.
data_description.api_key: Optional Launch Library API key. Matching keys share a conservative local 15/hour budget; a key does not automatically increase this local ceiling.
data_description.near_window_hours: Inside this window, polling speeds up to the live interval below.
data_description.near_interval_minutes: Minimum 5 minutes. Multiple sites share the request budget, so actual refreshes may be slower.
data_description.far_interval_minutes: How often to poll the rest of the time. Kept comfortably inside the free-tier rate limit by default.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Launch Library 2 with these settings. Check the site filter and API key, then try again.
error.no_location_match: No Launch Library location matches that site filter. Try a broader term (e.g. "Vandenberg" or "Cape Canaveral"), or leave it blank to track all launches worldwide.
error.request_budget: The shared Launch Library request budget is cooling down. Wait before retrying; repeated retries cannot bypass the limit.

abort.already_configured: A tracker for this site filter already exists.
